heardSemantics.decision: "Already delivered a campaign frame" means: an active binding of this consumer consumed a campaign frame from this transport, and the transport cursor has not moved since. A first frame, or a sequenced frame, that arrives while no binding is mounted is not remembered, so the remount keeps P2CG1F's window (no regression versus F; the continued lineage never folded that frame). Frames that do not move lastSeq (a baseline at sequence -1 after the first consumed frame cannot occur on a live transport; heartbeats, ACKs, proposals and errors are not campaign frames) leave the record valid
